ui_census.meaning: Scheduled time of the whole main/UI thread divided by capture-operation wall time. Overlaps per-stage wall timers. The interval encloses core setup/capture/finish and excludes outer disc preparation, settings refresh and report saving.

comparison.interpretation: Measured UI share is higher than earlier accepted runs. This supports the display-overhead diagnosis and the optimized-clear correction already shipped in 8bae3efe7c2f. It does not quantify how much of the difference comes from the clear alone, or establish that the pending update recovers it.

limitations: Reference result uses captured-stream CRC32. Saved files were not reread and no PC verification was supplied.
Different games/layouts from earlier performance references; no controlled same-disc UI comparison.
The duplicate DMA/PIO summary reports the same operation, not two sets of reads.
Earlier benchmark setup failures are separate from the later complete capture.
